newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms SBC, LTCB ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms SBC, LTCB ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Tuesday it had affirmed its ratings for Swiss Bank Corporation (SBC) and Long-Term Credit Bank (LTCB).
The ratings for SBC were A1 plus short-term, AA plus long-term, A/B individual and 1 legal rating.
The ratings for LTCB were A2 short-term, A minus long-term, D individual and 2 legal.
"This follows today's announcement that SBC are LTCB are entering into a strategic alliance," IBCA said.
In a press release, IBCA noted that the main feature of the alliance was setting up a joint investment banking venture in Tokyo in which both parties will own 50%.
The press release said the following.
The purpose of the agreement is to combine the investment banking expertise of SBC with LTCB's important client relationships in Japan.

Initially the joint venture is expected to have a total staff of approximately 700 of whom the majority are coming from SBC. In addition, the two companies are purchasing 3% cross shareholdings and SBC is underwriting preferred and subordinated debt issues of LTCB, of which it will retain a portion.
In the case of the cross shareholding, LTCB is issuing new shares. As a result of this transaction LTCB will be raising approximately JPY 160 billion of tier one capital.

However, IBCA noted that LTCB is likely to make further significant provisions in the current fiscal year which will more than offset the capital raised. In the case of SBC the transaction will have no material impact on its strong capital position.
